title: Luckin USA — Redis 监控 · B 视图 (MySQL 采集库)
description: Redis 全景监控,数据源 ldas / luckyus_db_collection。概览=全局问题集群 Top-N(与 A 视图对齐);明细随 $service。积分需采集器 --write 后生效。

list.name: service
list.label: 服务 (Redis 集群)
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT group_name FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info ORDER BY group_name
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT group_name FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info ORDER BY group_name

panels.title: 📊 概览 · 问题集群定位（全局,与 $service 无关）

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUUtilization' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='CPUUtilization') x

SELECT ROUND(MAX(x.average),1) AS value FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUUtilization' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='CPUUtilization') x

SELECT ROUND(MAX(x.average),1) AS value FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='EngineCPUUtilization' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='EngineCPUUtilization') x

SELECT ROUND(MAX(x.average),1) AS value FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='DatabaseMemoryUsagePercentage' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='DatabaseMemoryUsagePercentage') x

panels.title: 最低积分余额
panels.description: 采集器跑过 --write 后生效

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(MIN(x.average),1) AS value FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUCreditBalance' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='CPUCreditBalance') x

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUCreditBalance' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='CPUCreditBalance') x WHERE x.average < 50

panels.title: ⚠️ 最低积分余额 Top10
panels.description: 余额最低=最接近被限流

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.cluster_id AS `集群节点`, ROUND(m.average,1) AS `积分余额` FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUCreditBalance' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='CPUCreditBalance') m ORDER BY m.average ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT m.cluster_id AS `集群节点`, ROUND(m.average,1) AS `EngineCPU%` FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='EngineCPUUtilization' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='EngineCPUUtilization') m ORDER BY m.average DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT m.cluster_id AS `集群节点`, ROUND(m.average,1) AS `CPU%` FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUUtilization' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='CPUUtilization') m ORDER BY m.average DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT m.cluster_id AS `集群节点`, ROUND(m.average,1) AS `内存%` FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='DatabaseMemoryUsagePercentage' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='DatabaseMemoryUsagePercentage') m ORDER BY m.average DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT m.cluster_id AS `集群节点`, ROUND(m.average,3) AS `消耗/分钟` FROM (SELECT m.cluster_id, m.average FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics m JOIN (SELECT cluster_id, MAX(collect_timestamp) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUCreditUsage' GROUP BY cluster_id) t ON m.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND m.collect_timestamp=t.mx WHERE m.metric_name='CPUCreditUsage') m ORDER BY m.average DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.group_name AS `实例`, ROUND(g.hit_rate,1) AS `命中率%` FROM (SELECT g.* FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info g JOIN (SELECT group_name, MAX(collect_time) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info GROUP BY group_name) t ON g.group_name=t.group_name AND g.collect_time=t.mx) g ORDER BY g.hit_rate ASC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 🗑️ 最高驱逐(累计) Top10
panels.description: group_info 每日快照(累计计数,非速率)

targets.rawSql: SELECT g.group_name AS `实例`, g.evicted_keys AS `驱逐累计` FROM (SELECT g.* FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info g JOIN (SELECT group_name, MAX(collect_time) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info GROUP BY group_name) t ON g.group_name=t.group_name AND g.collect_time=t.mx) g ORDER BY g.evicted_keys DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.group_name AS `实例`, g.connected_clients AS `连接数` FROM (SELECT g.* FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info g JOIN (SELECT group_name, MAX(collect_time) mx FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info GROUP BY group_name) t ON g.group_name=t.group_name AND g.collect_time=t.mx) g ORDER BY g.connected_clients DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 💳 CPU 积分 明细（MySQL: cluster_metrics）

options.content: 本视图取自 **ldas** → `luckyus_db_collection`。积分来自 `t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics`(metric_name = CPUCreditBalance / CPUCreditUsage),由 `collect_cloudwatch.py --tasks redis_metrics --write` 写入。在采集器以新配置跑过一次(`populate_credits.sh`)前,积分相关面板显示 *No data*。

panels.title: 积分余额 CPUCreditBalance
panels.description: micro 上限 288 / small·medium 上限 576

targets.rawSql: SELECT collect_timestamp AS time, cluster_id AS metric, average AS value FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUCreditBalance' AND $__timeFilter(collect_timestamp) AND cluster_id REGEXP concat('${service:regex}','-[0-9]+$') ORDER BY collect_timestamp

panels.title: 积分消耗 CPUCreditUsage(每分钟)
panels.description: 持续 > earn(micro 0.2 / small 0.4 每分钟)= 净透支

targets.rawSql: SELECT collect_timestamp AS time, cluster_id AS metric, average AS value FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUCreditUsage' AND $__timeFilter(collect_timestamp) AND cluster_id REGEXP concat('${service:regex}','-[0-9]+$') ORDER BY collect_timestamp

SELECT collect_timestamp AS time, cluster_id AS metric, average AS value FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='CPUUtilization' AND $__timeFilter(collect_timestamp) AND cluster_id REGEXP concat('${service:regex}','-[0-9]+$') ORDER BY collect_timestamp

SELECT collect_timestamp AS time, cluster_id AS metric, average AS value FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_cluster_metrics WHERE metric_name='EngineCPUUtilization' AND $__timeFilter(collect_timestamp) AND cluster_id REGEXP concat('${service:regex}','-[0-9]+$') ORDER BY collect_timestamp

SELECT collect_time AS time, group_name AS metric, hit_rate AS value FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info WHERE $__timeFilter(collect_time) AND group_name REGEXP concat('^','${service:regex}','$') ORDER BY collect_time

SELECT collect_time AS time, group_name AS metric, connected_clients AS value FROM luckyus_db_collection.t_dba_collect_redis_group_info WHERE $__timeFilter(collect_time) AND group_name REGEXP concat('^','${service:regex}','$') ORDER BY collect_time
